subject: Acme Corp — Renewal & Expansion Recap / Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Coleman <alex.cole@acme.com>; Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Corp — Renewal & Expansion Recap / Next Steps

Alex / Priya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Summary of discussion:
- Current usage & traction: You’re averaging ~350M tokens/month across the search and summarization pipelines, with a mid-month spike to ~600M on promotion days. (I’ve attached the usage export we reviewed.)
- Pain points:
  - Latency: Search inference P95 has crept up to ~480ms on peak traffic; this impacts search relevance in the web UI.
  - Cost: Token spend has increased with higher context windows for summarization — want options to reduce unit cost without sacrificing quality.
  - Ops: Your team wants a simpler fallback and canary story for the nightly batch rerank jobs.
- Goals for renewal/expansion:
  1) Reduce peak P95 latency by ~30–40% for search.
  2) Reduce per-token cost on summarization by 20% while keeping ROUGE/semantic quality within current thresholds.
  3) Add a reserved pool to guarantee throughput for promo spikes and rollouts.

Proposed upsell path we discussed:
1) Move search workloads to a Dedicated reserved pool (3x T4s -> 2x A10s/1x A40 baseline) for predictable P95 and lower variance.
2) Apply a quantization + model-parallel variant for summarization (we recommended rwd-2-small-q4 + eval job).
3) Add Redwood Optimize package (evals + cost/quality tuning) for continuous monitoring and guardrails.

Timeline & next steps:
- Marissa (me): I’ll send the usage export, a draft MOP (migration/ops plan), and a preliminary SOW by EOD Friday (attached: Acme_usage_report_Q3.csv, Redwood_MOP_draft.pdf, SOW_draft.docx).
- Alex: Confirm internal budget window and approval owners by 9/9 so we can align pricing for a 10/1 start.
- Priya: Share the nightly batch job config and approximate QPS for rerank (Priya to send by 9/4).
- Rachel: I’ve looped you for pricing and a Dedicated capacity quote. Please prepare a 12-month reserved option + a 6-month flexible option.

Acceptance criteria for the pilot:
- Baseline P95 for search reduced to <= 300ms under normal peak load.
- Summarization average token cost reduced by >= 20% with no >5% drop in quality metrics on your eval set.

If I missed anything or you want the summary adjusted, say so and I’ll update. Appreciate the collaborative discussion — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Acme_usage_report_Q3.csv (CSV, 42KB); Redwood_MOP_draft.pdf (PDF, 180KB); SOW_draft.docx (DOCX, 95KB)

From: Alex Coleman <alex.cole@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>; Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Corp — Renewal & Expansion Recap / Next Steps

Thanks Marissa — clear recap and helpful framing. A few quick items from our side: 

- Budget: We’ve got an internal renewal review on 9/16. Targeting a 10/1 renewal start but will need final pricing and SOW by 9/10 to make that window.
- Nightly rerank: Priya will send the job config (she’s copied). Estimated QPS for rerank peak ~120 qps, sustained 30 qps.
- Evaluation: Can your team run the quantized summarization variant against our goldset and share the evaluation report within 5 business days of us providing the data? That will help the procurement team.

Apologies — one more ask: we have a SOC 2 evidence request — can someone on the Redwood security team confirm where audit logs for API requests would live under the Dedicated plan? We need that for procurement.

Alex
Head of Search, Acme Corp
alex.cole@acme.com | (617) 555-0110

Looks good — I’ll prepare two pricing options and include a SOC 2 evidence note for the Dedicated plan (logs stored in customer-controlled S3 + encrypted audit trail; I’ll include the SOC artifact reference and a short appendix explaining access patterns).

Plan:
- 12-month Reserved: baseline cluster (2x A40) + burst pool, committed discount, include Redwood Optimize trial for 90 days.
- 6-month Flexible: smaller baseline (1x A40) + autoscale, slightly higher unit price, shorter commit.

I’ll sync with Vivek on the MOP notes and get a draft SOW with line items by EOD Monday 9/7.

-Rachel
Senior Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference
